cards.name: Comorbid Sting

lines: "You may give one ally within Range 3 Poison to grant that ally:"

custom: top: applies a Plague token (class mechanic)
bottom: optional cost: give one ally within range 3 Poison; if you do, that ally is granted Attack 2 with Poison (no range printed: melee)
cards.notes: Class-wide: card numbers are printed with four digits and a 'G' prefix (G 0294 ... G 0322). Every corner box on this class has a '!' tab (XP and lost icons are mandatory); the '!' is not repeated in each summary. Icons: yellow pentagon with a dripping hand = Plague token (class mat), grey skull diamond = Poison, purple lightning diamond = Curse (perk sheet '+1 [this icon]' = GHS plus1 curse), brown '?' diamond = Muddle, dark-blue star diamond = Stun (perk sheet), red boot-with-roots diamond = Immobilize (perk sheet), grey open-hand diamond = Disarm (same icon as Bruiser Warding Strength), orange drip diamond = Wound, blue bicep diamond = Strengthen, pink shield-flame diamond = Ward, gold triangle-in-circle diamond = Bless, arrow-up-on-disc = Loot and figure-on-pad = Teleport (class mat icon legend).

cards.name: Xorn's Embrace

lines: "where X is the amount of Damage dealt with the granted attack ability. This heal ignores Poison (and does not remove Poison)."

cards.notes: Printed name 'Xorn's Embrace' (input 'xorns embrace'). Top: 'self' on the granted heal means each granted ally heals itself.

mechanics: Plague tokens (class mat): not negative conditions, no innate effects, cannot be removed by enemies; 12 in the supply (giving a 13th first removes any one placed token); up to 3 per enemy. GHS lists 'plague' under specialConditions

Applying Plague: Comorbid Sting top, Biting Gnats top, Path of the Pox bottom (chain of 4 enemies, range 3/2/1 hops, each at most once), Festering Sores top, Accelerated End top (extra Plague if the target already has one), Spread the Plague top and bottom, Cloying Miasma top, Rabid Bite top, Unwilling Sacrifice top (moves tokens to adjacent enemies), Wilt and Wither top, Compounding Infection top (+ trigger: 2 Plague), Mass Extinction bottom, Convert the Flock top and bottom, Disease Vector top; allies' attacks add Plague (Virulent Strain top)

Damage per Plague token on every enemy: 1 each (Virulent Strain bottom, Wilt and Wither top, Rot Maggots bottom at the end of 4 turns), 2 each (Disease Vector bottom); one enemy 2 per token (Unwilling Sacrifice top)
Attack/heal scaling by tokens: +1 Attack per token on the target (Wretched Yield top, Crippling Malady top), Heal X self = target's tokens before the attack (Wretched Yield top)
Round debuffs per token: -1 Attack (Blistering Buboes bottom), -2 Attack (Creeping Lethargy top), -1 Move on move abilities (Festering Sores bottom)

Abilities that only target enemies with Plague: Biting Gnats top (Muddle all), Vile Pestilence top (attack all at any range), Delirium's Danse bottom (Stun all), Crippling Malady top (2 at any range) and bottom (Immobilize all), Succumb to the Gift top, Mass Extinction top, Disease Vector top (Poison all), Path of the Pox top, Blistering Buboes top (damage 4/3/2/1), Accelerated End bottom (designate), Xorn's Embrace bottom (needs Poison and Plague)
Plague-conditional team buffs: advantage against plagued enemies this round (Cloying Miasma bottom); double damage suffered by plagued enemies during this and your next turn (Wilt and Wither bottom)

Optional 'give one ally within range 3 Poison to ...' costs (class mat: only to an ally that does not already have Poison): Comorbid Sting bottom (grant Attack 2 Poison), Delirium's Danse top (add Stun, XP 1), Gift of Rot bottom (advantage this round), Nightmarish Affliction top (+1 Target, XP 1) and bottom (6 use slots), Tainted Offering top (XP 1 + extra attack from the ally's hex)

Effects for allies that have Poison: Virulent Strain top (+1 Attack, Plague on their next 3 attacks), Contagious Corpse bottom (grant Shield 2), Gift of Rot top (Heal 1 + Ward), Sickening Strength top (Strengthen + may suffer damage 2 to play an extra card), Compounding Infection bottom (+1 Attack, character allies), Succumb to the Gift bottom (Bless), Tainted Offering bottom (Heal 2 + Strengthen + recover a level 1 card), Creeping Lethargy bottom (negate next damage, adjacent ally), Xorn's Embrace top (granted Attack 3 + Heal X), Spread the Plague bottom (target an enemy adjacent to a poisoned ally, then remove that ally's Poison, mandatory)
Poisoning allies as a side effect: Rot Maggots top (allies adjacent to the target), Accelerated End bottom (all figures adjacent to the designated enemy)
Heal as if the target had no Poison, keeping the Poison: Gift of Rot top, Tainted Offering bottom, Xorn's Embrace top
Granting abilities to allies: Comorbid Sting bottom, Contagious Corpse bottom, Xorn's Embrace top; extra card play for an ally: Sickening Strength top

Controlling enemies with Plague: Spread the Plague top (one enemy, Attack 4 + Plague), Rabid Bite top (Strengthen it, Move 1 toward a monster without Plague, Attack 5 + Plague; normal or elite only), Convert the Flock top (all normal and elite: Move 2, Attack 5 + Poison + Plague)

Kill triggers: Contagious Corpse top (XP 1 + shuffle a Curse into the monster modifier deck), Succumb to the Gift top (XP 1 + damage 3 Poison trap in the hex), Mass Extinction top (XP 1 + +2 Attack, +1 Target per kill), Convert the Flock bottom (XP 1 + optional Teleport to the hex), Festering Sores top (plagued enemy dies: discard to give 2 enemies within range 3 Plague)
Persistent discard triggers (no use slots): Festering Sores top, Compounding Infection top (enemy draws a Curse during its attack: it gains 2 Curse + 2 Plague)
Use-slot persistent cards: Virulent Strain top (3, discarded), Rot Maggots bottom (4, lost), Nightmarish Affliction bottom (6, lost), Wilt and Wither bottom (2, lost)
Attack performed from an ally's hex: Tainted Offering top
Trap creation: Succumb to the Gift top (damage 3 + Poison trap)
No summons (GHS availableSummons is empty too); no elements on any card
Conditions used: Poison, Plague (token), Curse, Muddle, Stun, Immobilize, Disarm, Wound, Strengthen (on allies; on an enemy in Rabid Bite), Ward, Bless; advantage
unclear: 'Target all' condition/heal abilities with no printed range (Biting Gnats top Muddle and bottom Poison+Muddle, Delirium's Danse bottom, Crippling Malady bottom, Disease Vector top Poison, Creeping Lethargy top Heal 1): whether they reach any range or only range 1 is a rules question. The attacks spell out 'at any range' (Vile Pestilence, Crippling Malady top, Succumb to the Gift, Mass Extinction); these rows don't

Text effects with no range ('one enemy that has Plague suffers ...', designate/control one enemy): Path of the Pox top, Blistering Buboes top, Unwilling Sacrifice top, Accelerated End bottom, Spread the Plague top, Rabid Bite top, Convert the Flock top and bottom, Xorn's Embrace top and bottom: whether range or line of sight applies is a rules question
Creeping Lethargy top: 'Heal 1: target all' — who 'all' covers (all allies, you included?) is not printed
Virulent Strain top: 'one of your allies that has Poison' — whether any poisoned ally's attacks use the slots, or one ally is chosen, is a wording question
Mass Extinction top: how '+1 Target' after a kill picks the next target (still 'enemy at any range that has Plague'), and whether each kill adds again, is a rules question
Sickening Strength top: what happens to the extra card the ally plays (discard/lost per its icons) is not printed
Tainted Offering bottom: the Recover icon (a card with a red check mark) read as 'Recover' from context ('one level 1 card from their discard pile')
